description: We're creating a new hemp industry in Hawaii. The Governor just signed our bill I cosponsored into law. HB1819 legalizes the growing, processing, and sale of industrial hemp in Hawai‘i. Hemp is an amazing crop that can create over 25,000 products. This big step forward will help local farmers develop a new cottage industry with Hawai‘i branding that can be recognized and exported.
